name: Hermean Heritor
body_text: With the restrictions on Hermean citizenship lifted, you may have fled the city of Promise or have spent some of your childhood in the company of someone who did. Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Constitution or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost. You're trained in the Society skill, and the Legal Lore skill. You gain the Multilingual skill feat or the Assurance skill feat for Society.
